create_lcm_generation_task_config: create a GenerationTaskConfig for LCM generation tasks with ROUGE metrics and configurable max generation length
create_lcm_validation_task_config: create a GenerationTaskConfig for LCM validation tasks using finetuning validation data and ROUGE metrics
register_lcm_generation_task: register the lcm_generation task with ParquetTestDataLoader for evaluating LCM text generation outputs
register_lcm_validation_task: register the finetuning_data_lcm.validation task for validating LCM model fine-tuning performance
configure_lcm_generation_metrics: configure ROUGE scoring metrics including rouge2, rougeL, and rougeLsum for LCM generation evaluation
